items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Oh, I used to see him all the time. In fact, we used to play together.

ctx.x: Did you ever see anything of him when you were young?

Oh, I used to see him all the time. In fact, we used to play together. See? Because he was another one of the guys who used to bring all his shoes to Papa's shoe shop. Alton Redd, the drummer that was with Kid Ory, lived right around the corner from me on a street called Champaign Street in Baton Rouge.
What street did you live on?
